card.statement: As an vector space, $M_q^{\mb{A}}(\lambda)$ is isomorphic to the space spanned by the order monomials $x_{i_1,-m_1}^-\cdots x_{i_l,-m_l}^-h_{j_1,-k_1}\cdots h_{j_r,-k_r}x_{o_1,p_1}^-\cdots x_{o_s,p_s}^-$ for $m_i\in \Z_{\geq 0}$, $k_i, p_i\in\Z_{>0}$ and $i_l, j_l, o_l \in I$.
card.label: Proposition 5

paper.title: Crystal bases for reduced imaginary Verma modules in type $ADE$
paper.abstract: We consider reduced imaginary Verma modules for the untwisted quantum affine algebras $U_q(\hat{\g})$ and define a crystal-like base which we call imaginary crystal base using the Kashiwara algebra $\mathcal K_q$ constructed in earlier work by Ben Cox and two of the authors. We prove the existence of the imaginary crystal base for any object in a suitable category $\mc{O}^q_{red,im}$ containing the reduced imaginary Verma modules for $U_q(\hat{\g})$.
